lede: The gondola's future takes center stage Monday when the Gondola Leadership Committee meets to work through funding commitments, a project update, and — notably — a governance action item that signals this is more than a routine briefing. Wednesday, Parks & Rec revisits the already-approved paving of the Town Park grass oval for basketball and pickleball courts, a project that's drawn more than 400 signatures in opposition and still has real heat behind it.

notable.stake: Gondola funding and governance action items up for committee decision.
Controversial Town Park paving project back before commission; 400+ signatures opposed.
